info.title: bsmapper
info.description: Local jobs API behind the bsmapper web UI. Map times are in beats.

get.description:
Environments v3 lighting can use: those with human light effects (most source
maps first), then those with the built-in template.

schema.title: Response List Environments Api Environments Get

get.description: Every job the server knows, oldest first: the queue order. Jobs last until restart.

schema.title: Response List Jobs Api Jobs Get

post.description:
Upload a song and queue a generation job. Options are multipart form fields.

Jobs run one at a time in the order they were queued; post one per song to queue a
batch.

get.description: Status and progress of a job.

delete.description:
Take a job off the list (and the queue, if queued) and delete its files.

Maps already installed in the game stay there. Cancel a running job first.

post.description:
Cancel a queued job, or stop a running one at its next pipeline step.

A cancelled regenerate keeps the earlier map (the job stays done).

409.description: Job is not queued or running.

get.description: Stream progress as server-sent events (replays missed ones on reconnect).

200.description: Server-sent events. Each `data:` line is one JobEvent as JSON, `event:` is its type and `id:` its seq. The stream ends after a done/failed status event.

get.description: The generated map for the preview, plus playability warnings.

409.description: The job has no finished map yet.

get.description: The song for the preview, aligned with the map (supports range requests).
The packaged map as a zip (Info.dat, difficulties, song.egg, cover).

409.description: The job has no finished map yet.

post.description: Redo one difficulty with a new seed/temperature. Follow it on /events.

Copy the map into Beat Saber's CustomLevels (set in ``~/.bsmapper/config.toml``).

Installing again replaces the earlier copy of this song.

409.description: No finished map, or the job is busy.

503.description: CustomLevels not found or the config file is invalid.

Arc.title: Arc
Arc.description: v3 'slider'. Head and tail usually sit on notes of the same color.

BasicEvent.title: BasicEvent
BasicEvent.description:
Classic (v2-style) light/environment event; also valid in v3/v4.

``type`` follows the game's event type ids (0-4 lights, 8 ring spin,
9 ring zoom, 12/13 laser speed, ...). ``color`` is an optional Chroma RGBA.

modes.title: Modes
modes.description: Repeat the field for several modes.

difficulties.title: Difficulties
difficulties.description: Repeat the field for several difficulties.

style.title: Style
style.description: 0 = flowy, 1 = technical; omit for no preference.

intensity.title: Intensity
intensity.description: 0.5 = typical human map, 1 = about the hardest 10%; omit for the configured default.

repetition.title: Repetition
repetition.description: Pattern reuse on repeated music: 0 = never, 0.5 = learned, 1 = twice as strongly; omit for the configured default.

light_style.title: Light Style
light_style.description: Look of model lights: auto, none, pulse, calm, scenes, flash or accent; omit for the configured default.

arcs.title: Arcs
arcs.description: Arcs on or off; omit for the configured default (else Hard up).

chains.title: Chains
chains.description: Chains on or off; omit for the configured default (else Expert up).

njs.title: Njs
njs.description: NJS for every difficulty; omit for defaults.

reaction_time.title: Reaction Time
reaction_time.description: Seconds from spawn to strike for Expert and Expert+; omit for defaults.

environment.title: Environment
environment.description: Info.dat environment for v3 lighting (GET /api/environments); omit to pick one for each song.

install.title: Install
install.description: Copy the map into the game as soon as it is generated.

DifficultyWarning.title: DifficultyWarning
DifficultyWarning.description: A playability issue (``interfaces.Issue``) tagged with the difficulty it belongs to.

maps.title: Maps
maps.description: Human maps its light effects come from; 0 = the built-in group-lighting template.

auto.title: Auto
auto.description: One of the environments picked when none is chosen.

EventBoxGroup.title: EventBoxGroup
EventBoxGroup.description:
v3 group lighting. ``boxes`` stays loosely typed until the lighting
workstream refines it; renderers own the per-environment group ids.

path.title: Path
path.description: The installed map folder inside CustomLevels.

warnings.title: Warnings
warnings.description: Things the player should know, e.g. Chroma is not installed.

filename.title: Filename
filename.description: Name of the uploaded audio file.

revision.title: Revision
revision.description: Bumped every time the map changes.

install_when_done.title: Install When Done
install_when_done.description: Copy the map into the game as soon as the first run is done.

installed.description: Where this revision of the map is installed in the game, if it is.

install_error.title: Install Error
install_error.description: Why the automatic install failed (the map itself is fine).

last_seq.title: Last Seq
last_seq.description: seq of the latest event; pass it as ?after= to follow new ones.

intensity.title: Intensity
intensity.description: Challenge within each difficulty: 0.5 = typical human map, 1 = about the hardest 10%; null = the server's configured default.

repetition.title: Repetition
repetition.description: How much repeated music reuses earlier patterns (note_v1): 0 = never, 0.5 = the learned amount, 1 = twice as strongly; null = the configured default.

light_style.title: Light Style
light_style.description: Look of model lights (light_v2 checkpoints): auto = picked for the song, none = the model's choice, or a style; null = the configured default (else auto).

arcs.title: Arcs
arcs.description: Arcs on or off in every difficulty; null = the configured default (else from Hard up).

chains.title: Chains
chains.description: Chains on or off in every difficulty; null = the configured default (else from Expert up).

njs.title: Njs
njs.description: NJS for every difficulty; null = defaults.

reaction_time.title: Reaction Time
reaction_time.description: Seconds from spawn to strike for Expert and Expert+ (lower difficulties keep their defaults); null = defaults (0.8 s and 0.7 s).

environment.title: Environment
environment.description: Info.dat environment (its look and colours), e.g. LizzoEnvironment, from GET /api/environments; null = picked for each song.

JobOptions.title: JobOptions
JobOptions.description: What to generate. Sent as multipart form fields next to the audio file.

RotationEvent.title: RotationEvent
RotationEvent.description: 90/360 rotation. ``degrees`` is relative and a multiple of 15.

JobEvent.title: JobEvent
